newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber mostly lower in after-hours session.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber mostly lower in after-hours session.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mostly weaker in the after-hours session on Monday, damaged by the yen's strength against the dollar, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.1 yen per kg firmer to one yen lower than the day's close. Benchmark July stood 0.1 softer at 151.1.
During the day, spot February expired at 152.2, 3.1 higher compared to the contract's after-hours session price last Friday. A total 209 deliveries were made.
Total trade volume during the day was 7,123 lots, an exchange official said. Traders said the currency market was expected to dictate direction in the rubber market on Tuesday.
